description: A message-layer vector: one section, one message, or a delivery's state, encoded, decoded or refused. The layer's three questions are separate kinds rather than one flag — whether the codec produces the right octets, whether it recovers the right value from octets, and whether it refuses octets for the right reason — because a corpus that conflated them could not fail a codec that round-trips an encoding it should have refused.
